coordinate_system: Pixels, origin top-left; positive x right, positive y down. All PNGs have identical full-canvas dimensions.
alpha: Straight RGBA PNG; normal source-over blending. Sky opaque.

camera.formula: screen_position = default_position - camera_delta * parallax + cloud_drift (clouds only)
camera.notes: Conservative starting settings, not engine-certified. No vertical overscan; vertical camera motion and vertical shake disabled. Test object overlaps at camera extremes in your engine. Increasing zoom crops the composition.

cloud_drift.notes: Render repeated copies; transparent horizontal borders permit wrapping. Art placement repeats every 2560 px; not a continuous opaque texture.

provenance.method: Built-in image_gen regenerated each depth layer. Generated sprites rescaled and positioned on shared canvas. Original reference was not manually cut or used as composited pixels.
provenance.limitations: Regenerated interpretation rather than pixel-identical reconstruction. Some architecture, terrain, cloud silhouettes and foreground details differ from reference. Native generator outputs were resized; not native 2560x1080 renders.

revision_notes: Sky tonal variation; snow along pavement edge; central/right distant colonnades partially concealed by local ice ridges within midground_ruins.png. Five other layers are byte-identical to previous version.
